∀ {Ξ Ω β : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ξ] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace β]
  (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ξ) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (W : Ξ → β) (Y : Ξ → Ω),
  Measurable W →
    Measurable Y →
      ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun W Y P →
        MeasureTheory.Measure.map Y P = μ →
          ∀ {E : Type} [inst_5 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_6 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (Φ : β → Ω → E),
            MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry Φ) →
              MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Φ (W ω) (Y ω)) P →
                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => ∫ (b : Ω), Φ (W ω) b ∂μ) P ∧
                  ∫ (ω : Ξ), Φ (W ω) (Y ω) ∂P = ∫ (ω : Ξ), ∫ (b : Ω), Φ (W ω) b ∂μ ∂P
